title: Questions for a model-vendor call
summary: The one-pager is smooth and incomplete. The director needs the questions it did not answer.
whatWeTest: Retention, training, private networking, evals, rate limits, outage history, and price at our volume are all covered.
outputHint: Reply with a numbered list of at least 8 questions. No preamble.

rubric.label: Fidelity
rubric.prompt: Are the claims grounded in the source, with gaps marked instead of filled in?

rubric.label: Constraints
rubric.prompt: Does it answer the decision the director actually has to make?

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.prompt: Can someone scan this in a few minutes and know what to do?
